name: 13-conference-crowd
prompt: A crowded, noisy conference expo hall with motion-blurred crowds rushing past the camera, bright harsh overhead light, lanyards with blank badges, overwhelming and chaotic, all signage completely blurred. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
